sources.notes: Use whole-program benchmarks, preferably MultiSource, SingleSource performance benchmarks, MicroBenchmarks, and CTMark. Keep SPEC under External for evaluation only unless licensing/access is explicitly available.
Numerical kernels with compile-time dataset sizes. Use multiple dataset sizes and repeated measurements.
Use CPU/OpenMP-capable workloads with validated input and verification commands.
Prefer programs and datasets with reproducible runtime measurements and correctness checks.
Use for representation diversity and static IR data. Do not treat compile-only programs as runtime-labelled examples.
Requires legitimate licensed access. Do not redistribute benchmark sources or results that violate license terms.
